title: feat(cli): os validate --target fetches the restriction profile from an environment URL
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9Y2yLH3VS5En8ea6L8PLhow)_
Fixes #31240

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none
Route: the seat ruled (step 0, option B) that this cloud route needs no spec route ledger entry: the ledger records the routes this repository's runtime serves, and the CLI only reads this one as a client.

`domain:server#3` · dev session `session_01ADHkmSfgXVignEEbsJjzMa`

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：`os validate --target` 除了本地 profile 文件，现在也接受环境的 http(s) URL：从该 URL 的 origin 取 `GET /api/v1/discovery/restriction-profile`，按 `{ success, data }` 读出，`data` 用 `RestrictionProfileSchema` 解析，判定和文件形式完全一致。
- 为什么改：卡 #31240，cloud PR #3732 已合入并发布该路由，作者不必再先把 profile 存成文件。
- 风险与回滚：无法访问、超时、非 2xx(含 404 RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND)、非 JSON、信封不对、schema 不合法，一律拒绝并点名 URL，绝不当成「没有限制」。文件形式不变。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/cli/src/utils/restriction-profile.ts` 的 `fetchRestrictionProfile` 与 `RESTRICTION_PROFILE_ROUTE`;`packages/cli/src/commands/validate.ts` 第 0 步改成 `await`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run src/utils/restriction-profile.test.ts test/validate-target-restriction-profile.test.ts`,预期 58 条全绿。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

**Step 0 (read-only, `origin/main` 0105a687).**

| Check | Reading |
|:--|:--|
| `discovery/restriction-profile` in the spec route surface (`packages/spec/src/api`) and the runtime route ledger (`packages/runtime/src/route-ledger.ts`) | 0 hits (`git grep -c restriction-profile`, exit 1). Control: the same trees name `/api/v1/discovery` (`dispatcher.zod.ts:103`, `plugin-rest-api.zod.ts:817`, `route-ledger.ts:248`). Seat ruling B above: no spec entry is owed. |
| `loadRestrictionProfile` on `main` | any `scheme://` target refused (`isUrl`) with "no defined address yet, save it as a JSON file"; then file missing / not JSON / schema-invalid each refused. Synchronous. |
| `validate.ts` step 0 on `main` | calls the loader first, before the stack is loaded; prints `Target profile` with the file path. |

**The route.** `RESTRICTION_PROFILE_ROUTE = '/api/v1/discovery/restriction-profile'`, named once in `restriction-profile.ts`. Its source is cloud PR objectstack-ai/cloud#3732 (cloud#3713), with the shape recorded on this card in comment 6716619631: `GET`, no auth, a `{ success, data }` body, `404 RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND` when the host names no environment, `503` otherwise. The code comment beside the constant cites both.

**The URL form.** `loadRestrictionProfile(target, cwd)` is now `async` and returns `{ profile, source }` (`source` = the file read or the URL fetched; it was `file`). For a `scheme://` target:

- only `http:` / `https:` are fetched; any other scheme is refused before a request, naming the file form as the remedy;
- the profile is fetched from `RESTRICTION_PROFILE_ROUTE` at the target's **origin** (a path, query or hash on the target is not used), with `accept: application/json` and a 15 s timeout;
- the body must be JSON and the `{ success: true, data }` envelope, checked locally (no new spec schema is exported); `data` is parsed with `RestrictionProfileSchema`, the same parse as the file form; schema issues are named under `data.`;
- every failure is refused, naming the URL fetched: unreachable or timed out, any non-2xx (the envelope's `error.code` is named when present; a 404 adds "no environment is served at this host"), non-JSON, wrong envelope, schema-invalid. None is read as "no restriction".

The file branch is unchanged except for the shared issue formatter (`profileIssues`), which prints the same text it printed before. `validate.ts` awaits the loader, prints `source`, and the `--target` flag help names the URL form.

## Tests

`src/utils/restriction-profile.test.ts`, new `describe('loadRestrictionProfile — an environment URL')` against a local `node:http` stub on `127.0.0.1:0` (never a real environment), 8 cases:

- parity: the stub serves a Team-shaped profile; the fetched profile equals the same content read from a file, the stub saw exactly one `GET /api/v1/discovery/restriction-profile` (target given with a path and query, so the origin rule is pinned), `source` is the route URL, and `judgeRestrictionProfile` returns the same rows for both;
- refused, each naming the URL: 404 `RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND`, 503, a 200 that is not JSON, JSON outside the envelope (bare profile; `success: false`), schema-invalid `data` (`data.allowCode`; and `{}`), a closed port (`ECONNREFUSED`);
- a `file://` target is refused naming the file form, and the stub saw no request.

`test/validate-target-restriction-profile.test.ts`, new `describe('os validate --target ENV_URL')`, 6 cases through `Command.run`: the same exit, `valid` and `errors` rows for an open and an `allowCode: false` profile from a URL as from a file; the text face prints the fetched URL; a 404, a non-JSON and a schema-invalid answer, and an unreachable environment, each exit 1 with `valid: false` and an `error` naming the URL.

Forced test changes:

- `src/utils/restriction-profile.test.ts`, the four existing file-form cases: `await` / `.rejects.toThrow` because the loader is now async. Their inputs and expected text are unchanged (CONTROL).
- `src/utils/restriction-profile.test.ts`, `refuses a URL rather than fetching from a guessed route`: removed, the behaviour this card replaces. Its successor is the `file://` case above.
- `test/validate-target-restriction-profile.test.ts`, `a URL target is refused, naming the file form as the remedy`: now feeds a `file://` URL (an `https://` one is fetched now); same assertion on the remedy, plus `valid: false`.

**Ablation (fail-open).** With the fix committed, `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` replaced the URL branch with one that turns any fetch failure into an all-open profile (marker `ABLATION_31240_FAIL_OPEN`; anchor 1 → 0, blob `1049b5a2cabe` → `13828918c01d`). Both files: `Tests 12 failed | 46 passed (58)`; the 12 are exactly the refusal cases: the 7 unit ones and the 5 command-level ones (the `file://` case included). The parity cases stay green, as they should. Restored with `git checkout HEAD -- …`; `git diff HEAD` 0 bytes, marker count 0.

## Acceptance notes

- The URL form uses the target's origin only. An environment served under a path prefix is not a shape the cloud route describes (`ENV_ORIGIN/api/v1/...`), so none is guessed.
- No auth header is sent: the route is unauthenticated per comment 6716619631.
